title: How I Broke the Family Computer

pre.en: Where is the old family computer now?
pre.zh: 那台家里的老电脑现在在哪儿？
options: In a repair shop in Chengdu
In a box under his dad's bed

intro: 这是小陈在本地技术聚会上的五分钟分享稿：九岁拆坏家里第一台电脑，反倒走上了写程序的路。讲稿有开场、有「先讲……再讲……」的路标，最后是现场提问。读的时候留意「动词 + 宾语 + 状态」：get it working、have it fixed、make him angry、left it running。

sentences.en: Hi, everyone, and thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 大家好，谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: After last year, you'll notice there are no slides.
sentences.zh: 有了去年的教训，大家会发现今天没有幻灯片。

sentences.en: So, first I'll tell you how I broke our family computer.
sentences.zh: 我先讲讲我是怎么把家里的电脑弄坏的。

sentences.en: Then I'll tell you how it made me a developer.
sentences.zh: 再讲讲它是怎么让我成了一名开发者的。

sentences.en: I was nine when my parents in Chengdu bought our first computer.
sentences.zh: 我九岁那年，成都的爸妈买了家里第一台电脑。

sentences.en: A week later, I took it apart, step by step.
sentences.zh: 一个星期后，我一步一步把它拆了。

sentences.en: I kept every screw in a teacup.
sentences.zh: 每颗螺丝我都收在一个茶杯里。

sentences.en: Putting it back together was a different story.
sentences.zh: 可装回去就是另一回事了。

sentences.en: I just couldn't get it working again.
sentences.zh: 我怎么弄都没法让它再开起来。

sentences.en: My dad had to have it fixed.
sentences.zh: 我爸只好拿去修。

sentences.en: The repair shop took two days and 300 yuan to sort it out.
sentences.zh: 修理店花了两天、收了 300 块才弄好。

sentences.en: I was sure it would make him angry.
sentences.zh: 我以为他肯定会发火。

sentences.en: By the way, that teacup's still at my parents' place.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，那个茶杯现在还在我爸妈家。

sentences.en: My mum won't drink from it.
sentences.zh: 我妈死活不肯用它喝茶。

sentences.en: Anyway, let me get back to my dad.
sentences.zh: 好了，说回我爸。

sentences.en: Instead of shouting, he handed me the programming book that came with the computer.
sentences.zh: 他没骂我，而是把随电脑送的那本编程书递给我。

sentences.en: "Have a go at this," he said.
sentences.zh: 「试试这个，」他说。

sentences.en: On Saturdays, I switched the computer on first thing in the morning and left it running all day.
sentences.zh: 每个星期六，我一大早就开机，让它开一整天。

sentences.en: I got into making little games, just for fun.
sentences.zh: 我迷上了做小游戏，纯粹是好玩。

sentences.en: Most of them didn't work, but I loved making them anyway.
sentences.zh: 大部分都跑不起来，可我照样做得很开心。

sentences.en: At thirteen, I got hooked on building things from scratch.
sentences.zh: 十三岁的时候，我迷上了从零开始做东西。

sentences.en: I built a calculator that got every answer slightly wrong.
sentences.zh: 我做了个计算器，每个答案都差那么一点点。

sentences.en: My maths teacher pointed out that seven times eight isn't fifty-four.
sentences.zh: 数学老师指出来，七乘八不等于五十四。

sentences.en: Then she started checking my homework.
sentences.zh: 然后她就开始查我的作业了。

sentences.en: So, all in all, it was the most expensive lesson my dad ever paid for.
sentences.zh: 所以总的来说，这是我爸付过的最贵的一堂课。

sentences.en: If your child takes something apart, it's worth staying calm.
sentences.zh: 所以要是你家孩子把东西拆了，先别急着发火，这口气忍得值。

sentences.en: Yes, at the back?
sentences.zh: 好，后面那位？

sentences.en: What happened to the computer?
sentences.zh: 电脑后来怎么样了？

sentences.en: Well, the second time I took it apart, I didn't tell my dad.
sentences.zh: 嗯，第二次拆它的时候，我没告诉我爸。

sentences.en: It's still in a box under his bed.
sentences.zh: 它现在还在他床底下的一个箱子里。

cards.note: 做演讲用的 PPT 每一页叫 a slide；a slide deck 是一整套幻灯片。
to separate something into its different parts
cards.tip: 宾语放中间：take it apart；装回去是 put it back together。
cards.example: He took the old radio apart to fix it.

cards.note: doing one thing at a time, in a fixed order
cards.tip: 放在动词短语后面，说一步一步慢慢来；拆电脑时尤其该这样。
cards.example: The guide explains the setup step by step.

cards.note: screwdriver 是螺丝刀；动词 screw 是「拧」。
repair 修理；也常说 a phone repair shop、a bike repair shop。
单复数同形：one yuan、300 yuan，不加 s。
to organise something that is untidy, or to deal with a problem
to reply to someone later, by phone, email or message
to try to do something, often for the first time
cards.tip: 英式口语，鼓励别人尝试时很常用：Go on, have a go!；后面接 doing 也可以：have a go at fixing it。
cards.example: I've never cooked fish before, but I'll have a go at it.

cards.note: very early in the morning, before you do anything else
cards.tip: 放在句中也行：switch it on first thing in the morning。
cards.example: I'll send you the report first thing in the morning.

cards.zh: 开始喜欢上；迷上（某爱好）
cards.note: to start to be interested in an activity
cards.tip: 后面接名词或 doing：get into photography / get into running。说「怎么入的坑」：How did you get into coding?
cards.example: She got into running during the lockdown.

cards.note: for enjoyment, not for money or a serious reason
cards.tip: 常加 just：just for fun；不说 for funny。
cards.example: I learned Japanese just for fun.

cards.note: to start to enjoy something so much that you want to do it all the time
cards.tip: on 是介词，后面接名词或 doing；比 get into 程度更深，有点「停不下来」。
cards.example: I got hooked on that TV series and watched it all in a week.

cards.note: from the very beginning, without using anything that already exists
cards.tip: 程序员常说 build / write sth from scratch；start from scratch 是「推倒重来」。
cards.example: We decided to rewrite the app from scratch.

cards.note: calculate 计算；calculator 就是「算的东西」。
英式说 maths，美式说 math；虽然有 s，但当单数用。
to tell someone something they did not know or had not noticed
used to give a general opinion after thinking about every part of something
cards.tip: 放句首，后面加逗号；讲话快结束时常用来下一个总的评价。
cards.example: There were a few problems, but all in all the launch went well.

cards.note: used to say that something is good or useful enough to spend time or money on
